elements.name: Cancel inserting a model-state table row

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user sets extrusion suppression in Primary and Capture State and leaves it computed in Copy State
the user opens the model-state table with d0 included
The MCAD Software has a model-state table with Primary, Capture State, and Copy State in that order
Capture State has extrusion status Suppress and d0 value 1 in
the user opens the context menu on the Capture State row number
Insert Row and Delete Row are available
the default-row, parameter-range and column commands appear disabled
a generated member row appears immediately after Capture State
the new row shows extrusion status Suppress and d0 value 1 in
the user cancels and reopens the table
only the original three member rows are shown in their original order
